title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Tier on Which an Additional Deposit Is Figured
content:
**Admissions deposit note — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The deposit tier of the additional deposit follows the room the resident now occupies.

- **Moved to another tier.** Where the agreement carries no isolation placement, records a move date, and its room-and-board span that begins latest (the one posted first where two begin on the same day) is for a tier other than the admission-month charge's tier, the deposit tier is that span's tier.
- **Isolation placement.** Where the agreement carries an isolation placement, it is the isolation billing tier of the agreement's tier, what the resident pays while placed there.
- **Otherwise** it is the tier of the admission-month charge.

| Agreement's tier | Its isolation billing tier |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |

**Points of judgement.** An agreement with a recorded move whose latest span is still for the admission tier: the admission tier. No move date recorded: the admission-month charge's tier, whatever the latest span shows.
